title: Page 6
content_zh:
不知道大家有没有看过《奇迹》这部韩剧，里面的异卵双胞胎姊妹互换了身体，而让她们的长才都有了发挥的空间，对她们的人生都产生了改变，这次，甜柠檬系列二月推出的强档主题书「月亮升起时」也是这样带点魔幻的故事，在月亮的魔力之下，主题书三本故事中的女主角都跟人交换了身体，进而得到一展长才的机会，同时圆满自己的姻缘。

在香弥的《村花有财气》中，女主角因为撞到脑袋，魂魄离体，附到了一个遭遇船难的皇商庶女身上，不只遇上了同样落难的男主角，展现野外求生的本领，让男主角对她刮目相看，更展现出赚钱的天赋，在皇商家获得一席之地，只是皇商庶女无意中目击了家里的一桩大秘密，为她招来了杀身之祸……这下她死了，回到自己的身体里，该怎麽跟男主角相认哩？

而裘梦的《密探有点忙》里，身为密探的女主角跟娇弱的相爷千金交换了身躯，只是两人都各有心上人，这一换身体可全都乱了套，而且还有来自皇亲国戚的威胁，意图把变成相爷千金的女主角抓走，更伪造通敌文书栽赃相爷，如果女主角没有当密探的经验，就要陷入大危机……

春野樱在《镇店女朝奉》中，则是安排女主角从富家千金变成了家道中落古董店的千金，振兴家业，避免自己被嫁给七老八十的老头当小妾换钱是她的第一要务，幸好她有着监定古董的好眼光，获得赏识，成为女朝奉，而东家不只长得俊俏、为人仗义，让女主角深深喜欢上他，但问题来了，东家有婚约，而那个婚约对象还是……身为富家千金的她自己！

三位女主角究竟要怎么做才能顺利圆满自己的爱情？而在换了身躯的期间，男女主角又会擦出什么火花？大家千万别错过「月亮升起时」主题书～

安阳陆府的一处院落里，传来女子呜咽的哭声，闻者无不鼻酸泪下。

陆家在安阳已扎根五代，是当地的老望族了，陆家出过状元郎，在前朝当过官，虽只是五品文官，也算是光耀门楣。

现时的当家老爷陆忠贤年轻时曾在京城闯荡，做了一些生意买卖，回到老家安阳购置了不少田地房产，如今靠着收租，生活倒也过得十分充裕富足。

陆忠贤有两个女儿，分别是亡妻所生的长女陆诗妍，以及继室赵氏所生的次女陆诗媚。

陆诗妍一出生便跟淮城富贾靳家的独子靳雪鸿订了亲，眼见着婚期在即，可是在一趟前往景安城的旅途中，她乘坐的马车意外翻落山坡，同行的车夫跟丫鬟伤重不治，而她被路过的商队发现时也已奄奄一息。

商队由在马车上发现的一只箱子看见了安阳陆府的印记，才得知昏迷不醒的她是安阳陆家的人，要不是有此贵人，恐怕她如今已是山坡下的一具冰冷屍体。

只是她人是救回来了，却一直昏迷不醒，脉象微弱。

看着她遭遇如此横祸，赵氏跟陆诗媚哭得忧心断肠。

「呜呜……诗妍啊，你醒醒，醒醒……」

「姊姊，拜托你醒醒呀！」

「孙大夫，求求你无论如何都要救我女儿……」陆忠贤眼眶里闪着哀切的泪光，声声央求道。

孙大夫无奈又歉疚的摇了摇头。「陆老爷，老夫……无力回天呀。」

赵氏脚步踉跄，差一点摔在孙大夫跟前，哭着问道：「孙大夫，诗妍她……她再也醒不来了吗？」

孙大夫面有难色，欲言又止，「这……」

「孙大夫，真的没法子了吗？」陆忠贤也不愿就此放弃希望。「不管要花多少银两都没关系，只要诗妍能醒来就好。」

「陆老爷，不是老夫不救，而是……」孙大夫再看了一眼头上缠着十几圈纱布的陆诗妍，又是一声长叹。「老夫就坦白的说吧，大小姐的头部遭到重创，醒来的机会微乎其微，或许就这么一睡不起了。」

陆忠贤听了，犹如五雷轰顶般倒退了两步。

身后的仆人赶紧上前搀扶住他，劝慰地道：「老爷，保重身体啊。」

听了孙大夫这番话，赵氏「哇」的一声，哭得更撕心裂肺了。「诗妍，我可怜的女儿……」她来到床边，紧紧握住陆诗妍的手。「你醒醒呀，诗妍，你这么一睡不起，教我跟你爹如何承受？你醒醒，诗妍，娘……娘捱不住这痛呀！」

「娘……」陆诗媚捱着赵氏，在一旁不停地拭泪。「娘，您别太伤心，要保重身子。」

「诗妍她、她……」赵氏哭得像是要岔气了似的。「我苦命的孩子，你不该去，不该去啊！」

「娘……」陆诗媚安慰道：「姊姊吉人天相，一定会醒的。」

赵氏听着，瞥了她一眼，继续放声痛哭。

第1章(1)

在一阵翻滚中，陆诗妍摔出了马车外，落在一块大石上，她勉强地睁开眼睛，鲜血流得她满脸，也流进了她的眼里。

四野静寂，听不见任何声响，马不嘶，人亦不语。

「老……老马……碧、碧……」她试着呼唤车夫老马跟丫鬟碧水，他们却没有回应。

她感觉到身体变得很虚弱，生命正在一点一滴的流失，她意识到自己即将走向生命的尽头。

她应该听父亲的话的，如果她不出门，事情就不会变成这样。

「老马……碧水……对、对不起……」她流下悔恨的眼泪，和着鲜血，一行行地滑落。

她的视线渐渐变得模糊，却又能清楚地看见那轮高挂在天上的明月。

今晚的月亮不是颗蛋黄，而是颗血色的夜明珠。

这是她第一次看到这么红的月亮，但或许也是最后一次了。

她的身体好疼、好冷，慢慢的，她失去了意识，坠入无边无际的黑暗中。

不知过了多久，她隐隐约约的听见细碎而模糊的声音，有人在说话，声音很急促。

有人来救她了吗？她……她有救了吗？

她努力的睁开眼睛，甚至试着要发出声音，「呃……」

「你这傻丫头！居然想上吊轻生？你想让爹娘也跟着上吊吗？」

陆诗妍幽幽转醒，仍有些模糊的视线里有两张气急败坏的陌生脸庞，她呆了一下，严厉训斥她的，是个年约五十的男人，身形有点瘦削。

她想问一声「你是谁啊」，可是她的喉咙好痛，让她发不出声音来。

「丽平呀，那金老板年纪是大了点，可身体还硬朗得很，虽说是委屈了你，但你至于寻死吗？」这会儿开口的是一旁身材丰腴的妇人。

她又是哪位？还有，她口中的丽平是谁？谁又是金老板？寻死？谁寻死了？她的脑袋里瞬间出现了好多疑问。

她清楚记得她乘坐的马车在前往景安城的山路上翻车，然后一阵翻滚，她、碧水跟老马连人带车翻落到山坳……对了，她现在究竟在何处？她不是还在那山坳里吗？

不对，这不是山坳，是一间陌生的房间。

「逼……逼……」她艰难地想发出声音，「逼……虽……捞马……」

看似是夫妻的中年男女皆是一脸疑惑的看着她，那名妇人问道：「什么？你说什么？」

「他们……栽、栽哪儿？」

「丽平，你究竟在说什么？」妇人焦急地看向丈夫。「孩子的爹，她是不是昏头了？要不要叫大夫？」

「请什么大夫！她不是好好的吗？」男人不以为然地道，「咱们向家现在是什么景况，哪有闲钱请大夫？」
content_en:
I don’t know if you have watched the Korean drama "Miracle". In it, the fraternal twin sisters exchanged bodies, which gave them room to display their talents and changed their lives. This time, the high-end theme book "When the Moon Rises" launched in February by the Sweet Lemon series is also a magical story. Under the magic of the moon, the heroines in the three stories in the theme book have swapped bodies with others, and then got the opportunity to show off their talents and at the same time consummate their marriages.

In Xiangya's "Village Flower", the heroine hit her head and her soul left her body and possessed the body of a concubine of an imperial merchant who was in a shipwreck. Not only did she meet the male protagonist who was also in trouble, she showed her ability to survive in the wild and made the male protagonist admire her with admiration., she also showed her talent for making money and got a place in the imperial merchants. However, the concubine of the imperial merchants accidentally witnessed a big secret in her family, which led to her death... Now that she is dead and returned to her own body, how should she recognize the male protagonist?

In Qiu Meng's "The Secret Agent is a Little Busy", the heroine who is a secret agent exchanges bodies with the delicate daughter of the prime minister, but both of them have their own sweethearts. This body change is all messed up, and there are also threats from the emperor's relatives, who intend to kidnap the heroine who has become the daughter of the prime minister, and even forge documents of collaboration with the enemy to frame the prime minister. If the heroine does not have the experience of being a spy, she will be in a big crisis...

Haruno Sakura arranged for the heroine to change from the daughter of a wealthy family to the daughter of a middle-aged antique shop in "The Shopkeeper". Her first priority was to revitalize the family business and avoid being married to an old man as a concubine in exchange for money. Fortunately, she has a supervisorThe good taste of antiques was appreciated and he became a female court servant. His boss was not only handsome and righteous, but also made the heroine fall in love with him. But the problem came. His boss had a marriage contract, and the marriage partner was... herself, the daughter of a wealthy family!

What should the three heroines do to successfully consummate their love?And during the period of changing bodies, what kind of sparks will the male and female protagonists create?Don’t miss the “When the Moon Rises” themed book~

In a courtyard of Lu Mansion in Anyang, the sound of a woman sobbing could be heard, making everyone who heard it shed tears.

The Lu family has been rooted in Anyang for five generations and is an old and prominent family in the area. The Lu family has produced a number one scholar and served as an official in the previous dynasty. Although it is only a fifth-rank civil servant, it can be regarded as a glorious lintel.

The current head of the family, Lu Zhongxian, once worked in the capital when he was young and did some business. He returned to his hometown of Anyang and purchased a lot of land and real estate. Now he lives a very prosperous life by collecting rent.

Lu Zhongxian has two daughters, the eldest daughter Lu Shiyan, who was born to his late wife, and the second daughter Lu Shimei, who was born to his stepmother Zhao.

As soon as Lu Shiyan was born, she was engaged to Jin Xuehong, the only son of the wealthy Jin family in Huaicheng. The wedding was just around the corner. However, during a trip to Jing'an City, the carriage she was riding in accidentally fell down the hillside. The driver and the maid who were traveling with her were seriously injured and died. She was also found dying by a passing caravan.

The caravan saw the mark of the Anyang Lu family from a box found on the carriage, and learned that the unconscious woman was a member of the Anyang Lu family. If it hadn't been for this noble person, she would have been a cold corpse at the foot of the hillside.

It's just that she was rescued, but she remained unconscious and her pulse was weak.

Seeing her encounter such a misfortune, Zhao and Lu Shimei cried heartbrokenly.

"Uuuu... Shiyan, wake up, wake up..."

"Sister, please wake up!"

"Doctor Sun, please save my daughter no matter what..." Lu Zhongxian begged with tears in his eyes.

Doctor Sun shook his head helplessly and apologetically."Mr. Lu, I...there is nothing I can do to save my life."

Mrs. Zhao staggered and almost fell in front of Dr. Sun. She cried and asked, "Doctor Sun, Shiyan...will she never wake up again?"

Doctor Sun looked troubled and hesitated to speak, "This..."

"Doctor Sun, is there really nothing we can do?" Lu Zhongxian was unwilling to give up hope."It doesn't matter how much money it costs, as long as Shiyan can wake up."

"Mr. Lu, it's not that I don't want to help, but..." Dr. Sun glanced at Lu Shiyan, who had more than a dozen circles of gauze wrapped around her head, and sighed again."I'll be honest, the eldest lady's head was hit hard, and the chance of waking up is very slim. She may not be able to sleep at all."

After Lu Zhongxian heard this, he took two steps back as if struck by thunder.

The servant behind him quickly stepped forward to support him and comforted him: "Master, take care of yourself."

After hearing what Dr. Sun said, Mrs. Zhao said "Wow" and cried even harder."Shiyan, my poor daughter..." She came to the bedside and held Lu Shiyan's hand tightly."Wake up, Shiyan, you can't sleep like this, how can your father and I endure it? Wake up, Shiyan, mother... mother can't bear this pain!"

"Mother..." Lu Shimei stood next to Zhao and kept wiping her tears."Mom, don't be too sad, take care of yourself."

"Shiyan, she, she..." Mrs. Zhao cried as if she was about to lose her breath."My poor child, you shouldn't go, you shouldn't go!"

"Mother..." Lu Shimei consoled her, "Sister, with the good fortune of heaven and earth, she will definitely wake up."

Mrs. Zhao listened, glanced at her, and continued to cry loudly.

Chapter 1(1)

During a tumble, Lu Shiyan fell out of the carriage and landed on a large rock. She reluctantly opened her eyes, and blood flowed all over her face and into her eyes.

The surrounding fields were silent, no sound could be heard, the horses did not neigh, and the people were silent.

"Lao... Lao Ma... Bi, Bi..." She tried to call the coachman Lao Ma and the maid Bishui, but they did not respond.

She felt that her body was becoming very weak and her life was draining away bit by bit. She realized that she was coming to the end of her life.

She should have listened to her father. If she hadn't gone out, things wouldn't have turned out like this.

"Old Ma...Bishui...Yes, I'm sorry..." She shed tears of regret, and mixed with the blood, and slid down line by line.

Her vision gradually became blurry, but she could clearly see the bright moon hanging high in the sky.

The moon tonight is not an egg yolk, but a bloody night pearl.

This was the first time she had seen such a red moon, but it might also be the last time.

Her body felt so painful and cold, and slowly, she lost consciousness and fell into the boundless darkness.

She didn't know how long it had passed, but she vaguely heard a thin and fuzzy voice. Someone was talking, and the voice was very urgent.

Has anyone come to save her?She...can she be saved?

She tried hard to open her eyes, and even tried to make a sound, "Uh..."

"You silly girl! You actually want to hang yourself? Do you want your parents to hang themselves too?"

Lu Shiyan woke up faintly, and there were two angry and unfamiliar faces in her still blurry vision. She was stunned for a moment, and the one who scolded her severely was a man about fifty years old, a little thin.

She wanted to ask, "Who are you?" but her throat hurt so much that she couldn't make a sound.

"Li Ping, boss Jin is a bit older, but his body is still very strong. Although I have wronged you, are you seeking death?" The person who spoke at this moment was a plump woman beside him.

Who is she?Also, who is Liping in her mouth?Who is Boss Jin again?Seeking death?Who seeks death?Many questions suddenly appeared in her mind.

She clearly remembered that the carriage she was riding in overturned on the mountain road to Jing'an City, and then rolled. She, Bishui, and Lao Ma all rolled down the mountain col... By the way, where is she now?Isn't she still in that mountain col?

No, this is not a mountain col, but a strange room.

"Fuck...fuck..." She struggled to make a sound, "fuck...even though...fishing for a horse..."

The middle-aged man and woman who seemed to be a couple looked at her with puzzled faces. The woman asked, "What? What did you say?"

"Where...did they plant them?"

"Li Ping, what are you talking about?" The woman looked at her husband anxiously."Father of the child, is she dizzy? Do you want to call the doctor?"

"Why are you calling a doctor? Isn't she in good health?" The man said disapprovingly, "What is the situation of our Xiang family now? How can we have the spare money to hire a doctor?"
